thought.text: India imports most of its crude oil, so oil prices feed into import costs, inflation and the rupee. Different sectors feel it differently, for example oil marketers, airlines and paint companies.

thought.text: Interest rates set the cost of borrowing. Higher rates tend to raise costs for borrowers and make fixed-income options more attractive compared with stocks, while lower rates work the other way. Rate-sensitive sectors such as banks, NBFCs and real estate are watched closely.
